note: Both sets suffer from significant errors due to reliance on the garbled text layer (e.g., inventing Symbol 151, swapping attributes between Symbols 150/50 and 31/32, and claiming data for empty Symbol 34). However, Set A correctly identifies the conductor material for Symbol 150 (AL) and Symbol 20 (CU), which are faithful to the image, whereas Set B misses the 150 material and gets the 20 configuration wrong. Set A also captures the correct ground value for Symbol 50 (#4G) even if misbound to 150, while Set B provides the wrong ground value for 50.
